name: The Curious Case of Julian Devorak
source:
When Julian suddenly finds himself being followed by a mysterious entity, he will need the help of not one, but two magicians to uncover the source of his predicament.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
当朱利安突然发现自己被一个神秘实体跟踪时，他需要的不是一个而是两个魔术师的帮助来揭开他困境的根源。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
